reason: Selecting a specific row requires a row-name target this cycle's read-only pass over LoadCharacterScreen.tsx did not confirm (row click handler is selectRow(row.characterId); the rendered row's accessible name was not traced to a specific field). Run manually, click the seeded character's row, click Load, confirm the sheet opens, then fold the confirmed steps back into this row.

Delete goes through window.confirm() (a native modal xdotool cannot address via the DOM probe) and Clone mutates the on-disk save set -- both degrade to manual per the harness brief's own guidance for window.confirm-gated actions.

Reaching the sheet depends on load-character-select-and-open, which is itself manual this cycle (see its own note). Once that row is confirmed, point every sheet-* row's `setup` at it instead of leaving this placeholder.

Only reachable when the seeded/loaded character is a caster the 'Add Spell' affordance is offered for (addSpellAffordanceModel.ts); confirm the seed character qualifies before trusting this unattended.

Clone mutates the on-disk save set (produces a new saved character each run) -- confirm success and then delete the clone by hand (see load-character-delete-clone) rather than letting an unattended run accumulate clones.

Actually selecting 'Export' opens a native OS save dialog (see the top-level manual-character-export row) -- this row only proves the menu itself renders all five items; do not click Export from here unattended.

Requires at least one campaign to exist (DmToolkitScreen shows an empty-state message otherwise: 'Create one in Campaign Manager first.') -- run campaign-create first if the profile has none, then confirm the seven DM_RECORD_KINDS tab labels render together.

Editing an existing record requires selecting a specific list row first, whose accessible name (the record's own title) this cycle's read-only pass did not enumerate against seeded data. Run manually and fold the confirmed row-select step back in.
Same dependency as dm-toolkit-edit-record, plus deleteDmRecord's own confirmation UI was not traced this cycle.
exportConsole() drives runDmConsoleExport, whose completion surface (native save dialog vs. in-app confirmation) was not confirmed live this cycle.

A numeric rating only appears once both a party member AND a monster are added (rate_encounter needs both); this cycle's read-only pass confirmed the empty-state copy but did not add a party member live. Run manually: add a saved character AND the Ankheg row, then confirm 'Rating' shows a CR/difficulty word plus a number, not the empty-state sentence.

The Campaign Manager banner is gated disabled until a local Drive folder is configured (see landing-campaign-gate) -- confirm Google Drive settings are configured on the smoke profile first, or this click is a no-op on a fresh profile.
handleImport opens a native OS file-open dialog (Tauri's dialog plugin) -- xdotool has no DOM to drive inside it.
handleExport / the sheet menu's 'Export' item open a native OS file-save dialog.
PortraitUpload opens a native OS file-open dialog for the image file.
